settings.label: General
settings.description: Account, theme, accent, language, timezone, and desktop notifications.

settings.label: Account
settings.description: Who is signed in, and sign out.

settings.label: Theme
settings.description: Follow the system, or choose light or dark.

settings.label: Accent colour
settings.description: Accent colour used across the app.

settings.label: Timezone
settings.description: Timezone used when this browser shows dates.

settings.label: Approval rules
settings.description: Server rules for shell, secrets, deletes, and new sites. They are not switches on this page.

settings.label: Policy
settings.description: Allow, ask, or deny each action class, and edit the hard-deny list.

settings.label: Computer
settings.description: Paired devices, and whether each computer may run commands, route traffic, read files, or use the browser.

settings.label: Vault
settings.description: Save API keys and passwords, including the platform key.

settings.label: Plugins
settings.description: Install and connect MCP servers, OpenAPI APIs, and built-in apps, then enable them for a teammate.

settings.label: Usage & Billing
settings.description: Credits, usage, cost, latency, and the quota for this account.

settings.label: Updates
settings.description: The installed version, and whether a newer application image is available.

settings.label: System
settings.description: Admin health for the database, computer isolation, computers, stuck tasks, invites, and recent model prompts.

settings.label: Notification inbox
settings.description: Account notices for invites, runs, and billing; mark notices read.

panels.label: Details
panels.description: Side panel for this teammate: title, description, coding jobs, routine summary, connected apps, channels, and members.

panels.label: Library
panels.description: Workspace files, media, and saved artifacts.

panels.label: Computer
panels.description: The live desktop. Take control when you need the pointer.

panels.label: Routines
panels.description: Recurring tasks. A routine runs on its schedule even when this page is closed.

panels.label: Coding jobs
panels.description: Live coding jobs, progress, pull requests, and job details in the Details panel.

panels.label: Tasks
panels.description: Assigned tasks, status, errors, and saving a run as a skill in the Library.

panels.label: Skills
panels.description: Saved workflows that can be replayed without another model call.

panels.label: Plugins
panels.description: Plugins enabled for this teammate. Connect a new app from Settings.
